visualCharacteristics: Default: rows of equal columns side by side on desktop, stacked on mobile with image cells first.
text: two equal top-aligned text columns, large h2 on the left, paragraphs on the right.

media-text: rows of [text | image] or [image | text] in visual order; text cell has h2, a sky-blue (#00a1dc) rule from an authored <hr>, then paragraphs; the image fills its column (3:2) with a narrow vertical tab strip on the edge facing the text, green on odd rows and sky/navy on even rows. Stacks on mobile with the image first.
usage: Fixed side-by-side content pairs. Columns (text) for a heading beside body copy; Columns (media-text) for alternating text and photo rows.
reuseGuidance: One row per pair, cells in visual order. For media-text, put an <hr> (---) between the h2 and the paragraphs in the text cell; the image cell holds only the picture.
